positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (12.5): 1.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 45 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 4.2% of months (24 months).

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Jan 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date).

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 230 m, Boon Keng MRT about 860 m; closer than 553 of 662 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 430 m; more than 547 of 662 similar developments (the same as 73). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 370 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 380 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,270 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 510 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,280 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,330 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,460 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,560 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,600 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,610 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 351 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 124 new sales and 1,018 resales (1,142 purchases); new sales were 10.9% of these purchases. Subsales (51) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,018 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,082 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.9%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
